root_cause_label: Wrong Output Path Contract (reports/ subdirectory instead of /app root) + Invalid IP Error Message Mismatch
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent writes alert.json and report.json to /app/reports/ instead of the required /app/ directory, and echoes 'Error: Invalid IP address format' instead of the required bare word 'invalid' for invalid IP inputs, causing pytest tests to fail despite the agent believing all requirements are met.
t_err_evidence: Step 8: agent sets OUTPUT_DIR='/app/reports' in intrusion_detector.sh, hardcoding output to the /app/reports/ subdirectory instead of /app/ root as required by the spec; also in Step 9 response.sh echoes 'Error: Invalid IP address format' instead of the bare word 'invalid'.
t_commit_evidence: Step 8 writes the intrusion_detector.sh with OUTPUT_DIR='/app/reports', and Step 9 writes response.sh with the wrong error string; both scripts are used from this point forward without correction, locking in both failures.
trigger_explanation: The agent never verified where the spec required output files to land (at /app/ root vs a subdirectory), and never verified what exact string to output for invalid IPs. It assumed /app/reports/ was a natural output directory (a pre-existing directory visible in Step 1) and assumed a human-readable error message was acceptable, without checking the spec requirements for exact output path and exact error string.
